reviewNotes: Unreviewed AI translation drafts for Arabic (ar), Urdu (ur), and Persian (fa) nursery-to-field planting observation UI. Intended drafting boundaries: (1) Observed field planting is distinguished from planned field entry (UTC calendar date) and saved plan references; (2) Planted count requires an integer number where explicitly entered 0 is zero and blank is uncounted; (3) Observations do not deduct stock, determine survival (بقاء / بقا), or mark batches complete; (4) Checked labels express selected entered label text values stored as entered at observation, avoiding photo/image capture connotations, and do not verify seed identity or establish earlier sowing/count records; (5) Evidential non-implication in ar12 (لا يستدل منه) avoids denial of record content; (6) fa25 explicitly coordinates both negative clauses (neither verifies seed identity nor identifies specific records); (7) ur03 restores assigned growing space; (8) Stored evidence withheld pending review remains distinct from an ordinary unlinked note; (9) Exact ASCII literals DEMO, UTC, and 0 are preserved without directional control characters, HTML, or invisible isolators; (10) Text-only RTL candidates do not establish UI bidi/layout readiness. Terms for human review: naturalness of nursery raising batches versus field planting terms in local grower idioms. No runtime activation or semantic certification is claimed.
